title: Master's Programs (MP1, MP2), Admission 2027-2028
institution: National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies (GRIPS)
about: GRIPS is accepting applications for 2027-2028 admission to its master's programs (MP1 and MP2) from applicants residing outside Japan. The Online Registration Form is due April 30, 2027, 17:00 JST, and supporting documents by May 7, 2027.
requirements: Online Registration Form may be submitted only once per academic year
Complete set of supporting documents by post
Incomplete or late applications are not considered
